title: Flames and Fate
description: Var'Kennan's influence reaches deeper into Caeloran society. Find a way to liberate the people of Caelora.

objectives.text: Dismantle the Order of Truespawn to stop the Dwarven genocide.
Sneak into High Camorant to get the lay of the land.
Contact the Figure in hopes of finding a way to fight Var'Kennan.
Feed fuel to the growing fire of unrest in the Highlands.

developments.session: Breaking the Axis, Chapter 3 - The Smooth Criminals
developments.text: During the investigation of High Camorant, we discovered new clues about Var'Kennan's plans as well as ways to possibly defeat him.

title: The Wayward Son
description: Ashton has been captured by Dyra, and the party must find him before it's too late.

objectives.text: Locate and save Ashton.
Deliver Ashton to Voltegar in Avilon.
Discover what is inside the mysterious orb.

developments.session: Breaking the Axis, Chapter 2 - The Unforgiven
developments.text: We confirmed that Ashton is not in the orb that was recovered during combat with Dyra and Bix.

developments.session: Team 1, Chapter 5 - Meet Me in the Woods
developments.text: Dyra captured Ashton while the team was fighting and left an ominous note.

title: Beyond the Sea
description: A massive glacier surrounds the island, fabled to bring death to any adventurer who goes near it.

objectives.text: Pay a visit to the Undersea to find a way to make it to the glaciers.
Learn more about Wintheria and her connection to the party.

title: The Crystal's Calling
description: A mysterious crystal connects Quill to mysterious forces and deities.

objectives.text: Investigate the crystal's origins.
Discover the nature of its resonant connection.

developments.session: Breaking the Axis, Chapter 2 - The Unforgiven
developments.text: Quill acquired a featherdrive, adding another curious possession to his growing collection of discoveries.

developments.session: Breaking the Axis, Chapter 1 - The Chain
developments.text: Bix managed to freeze Quill in place by connecting to the crystal.

title: The Death Cheater
description: Caedes' connection to the book puts him at odds with his team and the goddess of death herself.

objectives.text: Discover the book's motivations and origins.
Heed Nihelia's warning... or don't.
Keep a close eye on Mari and discover the motivations behind the attempt on your life.

developments.session: Breaking the Axis, Chapter 2 - The Unforgiven
developments.text: Caedes' arm has grown slightly dimmer, a subtle change that may hint at something shifting within him due to the spell he used to save Oliver.

developments.session: Team 1, Chapter 5 - Meet Me in the Woods
developments.text: Mari attempted to kill Caedes, which has festered a sense of distrust within the party.
We now know that the book is searching for a vessel to be reborn in.

title: The Hardened Heart
description: A simple errand led to a chain reaction that has the humble Balthrum traveling Caelora, and it might hit closer to home than he thinks.

objectives.text: Locate the fabled mug for your wife.
Dive deeper into your past memories.
Assemble a ripcord-powered rocket axe, with the help of Fishsticks.

title: Fable of Feathers
description: Mari's origins are mostly shrouded in mystery and secrets, but somewhere deep down there's a far more complex soul than meets the eye.

objectives.text: Discover the truth of your lineage.
Return to or reject the influence of the Figure.
Dispose of Caedes Mortem. (FAILED)

developments.session: Team 1, Chapter 5 - Meet Me in the Woods
developments.text: Mari attempted to kill Caedes, which has festered a sense of distrust within the party.

title: The Kensei's Chance
description: Jorovindr travels the continent in search of purpose... and rocks.

objectives.text: Find the stone giants and rescue them from the Highlands.
Find a use for the mysterious stone from the festival.

developments.session: Breaking the Axis, Chapter 2 - The Unforgiven
developments.text: Jorovindr purchased an amethyst while exploring a satin cave. Meanwhile, the mysterious stone from the festival has been discovered to have the power to grow once more, returning to its former size and potentially offering a devastating new use as a crushing weapon.

title: The Warden's Stranding
description: Maria and her brother have been stranded on Caelora with their memories clouded by amnesia. Find a way home.

objectives.text: Travel to the Highlands to find your brother.
Discover how you got to Caelora, and find a way to return home.
Discover the usage for the mysterious keys.
Reconnect with your brother.
Help your brother get to know you once again.

developments.session: Breaking the Axis, Chapter 3 - The Smooth Criminals
developments.text: During the heist on High Camorant, the heroes brought Cody home from their strange prison, but he seems to have changed significantly since the last time we saw him.
Vae'Saron seems to think that your brother might be somewhere in the Highlands, which is the domain of Var'Kennan.

title: A Son's Burden
description: Oliver is no longer at sea and must come to terms with his past in order to discover his true self.

objectives.text: Find and free your mother.
Figure out why part of your face is made of dead skin, and why it isn't healing.
Find the truth behind the vision you had between life and death.

developments.session: Breaking the Axis, Chapter 2 - The Unforgiven
developments.text: Oliver nearly died from his gunshot wound, and had a strange vision of a beach and a young girl before being resurrected by Caedes. He was also heard giggling in his sleep, an unusual occurrence that may hold more significance than it first appears.

title: Fraud Watch
description: Grimsley has joined our team of adventurers, and maybe his own selfish motivations will align with that of our heroes.

objectives.text: Dive deeper into your relationship with Wintheria.
Establish yourself as a valid member within the team.

title: Shining Through the Darkness
description: Waxborns rarely wander far from their creator, and Glim has certainly done that. In search of purpose and joy, she travels the continent alongside our heroes.

objectives.text: Speak to Vae'Saron about where you come from.

developments.text: Glim has split from the party to discover her origins in Homeward Reach.
